canonical_name: No Post-Acquisition Supply Chain Risk Management Plans
description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans are not monitored post-acquisition.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of provisions in SCRM plans for post-contract or post-partnership activities. Check for lack of processes to handle data return, asset recovery, or ongoing obligations after supplier relationships end.
